env._comment: Baked into the bundle at build time — changing the server means rebuilding the APK. This is an Elastic IP, so it survives instance stop/start; a plain public IP does not, and every installed APK would break silently the first time the box restarted. Must be the nginx origin (port 80/443), never :3000: the API is loopback-bound. Plain HTTP works only because app.json keeps usesCleartextTraffic:true; switch both to https:// the moment a domain and cert exist.
